answer: To register, an agent locks an NFT held as collateral as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. An agent caught selling an identity to a new operator is exposed by key-rotation monitors. The penalty follows at once: the identity freezes until a jury acquits and releases the bond. Each bond sits in its own terrace, seizable in one transaction. The mesa test is simple: one bond, one identity. No walnut means no registration: the bond comes first.
